user.title: Xplor Deciplus
user.description: Sign in with your club member account (the one used on member-app.deciplus.pro).

data_description.domain: The name after member-app.deciplus.pro/ in your club's member area address, or just paste that address.
data_description.email: Email of your club member account.
data_description.password: Password of your club member account. Stored to renew the access token when it expires.

zone.title: Choose the club
zone.description: This account has access to several sites. Pick the one to sync; add the integration again for another site.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Xplor Deciplus
reauth_confirm.description: The access token for {email} at {domain} was rejected. Enter the password again.

abort.already_configured: This club is already configured for this account
abort.wrong_account: These credentials belong to another member account

data_description.scan_minutes: Minutes between two refreshes of the planning (2–60). Booking openings are refreshed on time regardless.
data_description.days_ahead: How many days of sessions to load (7–28). Openings appear 14 days before a class, so 21 shows next week's openings.

book_session.name: Book a session
book_session.description: Books a session; when it is full, joins its waiting list unless disabled.

session_id.name: Session
session_id.description: Session id, as in the event description ("Séance n°1013") or any calendar event uid ("opening-1013", "session-1013", "booking-1013", "waiting-1013").

waiting_list_fallback.name: Waiting list fallback
waiting_list_fallback.description: Join the waiting list when the session is full.

place_id.name: Seat
place_id.description: Seat id for sessions with a seat map. Left empty, the first free seat is taken.

guests.name: Guests
guests.description: Extra anonymous places to book with you (0–5), if the activity allows invitations.

cancel_booking.name: Cancel a booking
cancel_booking.description: Cancels a booking or leaves the waiting list of a session.

session_id.name: Session
session_id.description: Session id, as in the event description or uid.

no_free_seat.message: No bookable seat is left on the session's seat map

not_enough_places.message: Not enough free places left for you and your guests

session_full.message: The session is full and the waiting list fallback is disabled

entry_not_loaded.message: The targeted device is not a loaded Xplor Deciplus club
